rows.en: (Let's see, my next class is......)

All of you, take your seats, quick.
Class is starting.
(Oh, it's Pinon-chan's class.)
In short, since this part works like this......

This will be on the test,
so make sure you remember it.

All right, that's it for today's class.
Class duty, give the command, please.
rows.notes: Pinon. nicchoku = the student on class duty, who calls 'stand, bow'.

rows.en: All rise...... Bow.
rows.notes: Pilot Student A, the student on class duty.

rows.en:
(I still can't get used to the idea
of Pinon-chan being a teacher...)
(Oh, it's Pinon-chan's class.)

(I still can't get used to the idea
of Pinon-chan being a teacher...)

...If you solve it like this,
you'll have no problem.

(Pinon-chan's really settled into being a teacher.
Lately it doesn't even feel weird anymore
that she's a teacher...)
...In other words, this is how it works, nya!
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. She flubs 'na n da' into 'nyan da'; rendered with her 'nya'.

rows.en: She flubbed it...
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders, muttered aloud; Pinon hears it. 'flub' follows frd_pnn_002 (c12008).

rows.en: I did NOT flub it!!

R-right...
You didn't flub it, Pinon-chan.
Don't you pity me!!
Whaaat?!

Dammit! Just because a genius like me slipped up
a little, you think you're so smart...!
You'll pay for this!!
rows.notes: Pinon. oboetero yo, parting shot as she storms off.

rows.en: (Pinon-chan went home...)

(Looks like Pinon-chan's road to becoming
a full-fledged teacher is still a rough one.)

(Pinon-chan's really settled into being a teacher.
Lately it doesn't even feel weird anymore
that she's a teacher...)

R-right...
You didn't flub it, Pinon-chan.
(Pinon-chan went home...)

(Looks like Pinon-chan's road to becoming
a full-fledged teacher is still a rough one.)

(Phew, the test is over.
Now I can finally catch my breath.)

Pinon-chan, why are you glaring
at that test paper?

Well, there's just something on the test
that's bothering me...

It's rare for you to get stuck on schoolwork,
Pinon-chan. It sure was a hard test, though...

When did anyone say I was stuck on a question
this easy? Something like this is obviously
a piece of cake for me.

S-sorry...
Then what's bothering you?

It's this question here.
Just as I thought, the question itself
seems to have a mistake in it.

Sure, it's an easy part to get mixed up on,
but for a teacher, someone who teaches others,
to get it wrong...
rows.notes: Pinon. The teacher who wrote the test is unnamed.

rows.en: I'm going to go have a word with them.
rows.notes: Pinon. The teacher who set the test is unnamed and of unknown gender: 'them'.

rows.en:
(I didn't notice there was a mistake at all...
Pinon-chan really is a genius.)

(Phew, the test is over.
Now I can finally catch my breath.)

(I didn't notice there was a mistake at all...
Pinon-chan really is a genius.)
(What should I do for fun today~?)

\p-kun,
it's hot again today!
You're full of energy as always, Ranka.
Doesn't summer just give you energy?

It sure gets me fired up,
though I don't know why.

Let's invite everyone and go somewhere
sometime.
Well then, I'm heading home~

\p-chan,
it's hot again today~!
You're full of energy as always, Ranka-chan.

It sure gets me fired up,
though I don't know why.
Ranka, I can't wait for Sheryl's concert!

I've been so excited lately,
I haven't been getting enough sleep.

I wish the concert would hurry up and get here~!
I can't wait~

Don't get so carried away
that you end up running a fever.

Of course!
It'd all be pointless if I couldn't go
to the concert.
Well then, I'm heading home.
(Now even I'm getting all fired up~)
(Sheryl's concert is almost here!)
Ranka-chan, I can't wait for Sheryl's concert!
(Now even I'm getting all fired up~)

They found a planet we can live on!
That's really amazing, isn't it,
\p-kun?!

Ranka, aren't you worried at all
about the new planet?
It's not like I'm not worried at all...

But I'm more excited to see what's
going to happen on the new planet.

I hope we have even more fun than before,
\p-kun!

Yeah, you're right...
Worrying about it won't do any good.
That's right, \p-kun!

(With Ranka and everyone around,
we're bound to have a great time.)

They found a planet we can live on!
That's really amazing, isn't it,
\p-chan?!

Ranka-chan, aren't you worried at all
about the new planet?

I hope we have even more fun than before,
\p-chan!

Yeah, you're right...
Worrying about it won't do any good.
That's right, \p-chan!

(With Ranka-chan and everyone around,
we're bound to have a great time.)
